scenarios.title: Poisonous gives the damaged player poison counters when the creature deals combat damage to them
decisions: A attacks player B with Virulent Sliver.
No spells or abilities are used; combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: unblocked
variants.expected: Virulent Sliver deals 1 combat damage to B (life 19). Its poisonous 1 triggers and B gets 1 poison counter.

variants.label: blocked
variants.delta: B blocks Virulent Sliver with Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Virulent Sliver deals its damage to Grizzly Bears and dies. No combat damage is dealt to B, poisonous does not trigger and B has no poison counters.

scenarios.forge_notes: Virulent Sliver grants Poisonous:1 to every Sliver, itself included.

scenarios.title: Each instance of poisonous triggers separately
decisions: A attacks player B with the Virulent Sliver that is not summoning sick.
No spells or abilities are used; combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: two_instances
variants.expected: The attacker has two instances of poisonous 1. Both trigger and B gets 2 poison counters. B's life is 19.

variants.label: one_instance
variants.delta: A controls only one Virulent Sliver (the attacker).
variants.expected: The attacker has one instance of poisonous 1. B gets 1 poison counter. B's life is 19.

variants.label: blocked
variants.delta: B blocks the attacking Virulent Sliver with Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: No combat damage is dealt to B. Neither poisonous instance triggers and B has no poison counters.

scenarios.forge_notes: Two Virulent Slivers each grant Poisonous:1 to the attacker; confirm Forge keeps both as separate keyword instances.
